analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md (head lines 142-153). It rewrites the CI build-cache description: only pushes to dev or master save a cache, and pull requests restore the base branch's entry and save nothing. It also adds a paragraph saying the MiMo audio gate (testNativeAudioRelease, 1.87 GB codec fixture) runs only when MIMO_AUDIO inputs change, and on every master push. I read the whole supplied document, both units, against the threat model. No runtime code, provider keys, attestation, coordinator WebSocket contract, prefix-cache storage (T-041) or App Attest authorization (TB-011) is touched. The change is a documentation and CI-process description. Possible concerns: PR-triggered builds no longer write caches, which reduces cache-poisoning surface and is a security-positive effect; the gate runs conditionally on path changes, so a PR outside MIMO_AUDIO inputs skips native audio qualification, but the doc says master pushes run every component. The actual CI workflow files, scripts/ci-component-paths.py and build.md#ci-caching were not supplied, so I cannot verify that the doc matches real behavior (for example that PRs really save no cache, or that the MIMO_AUDIO path list is complete). This is an unverified contract, not a finding. The doc also says the former 'main' branch is dropped from cache saving; this too depends on workflow configuration outside the evidence. No threat-model update is needed for this PR.
